page.layout: One printed title page, centred in a double rule frame; no columns or margins with text. Below the frame a handwritten shelf mark (not transcribed).

main_text.l: Non five molle gravat semper sunt commoda: namque
Gemmina extla magis quàm magno pondere ferrum.
M D C X X X I.

page.notes: Blue library oval stamp (partly obscuring the text at left, reading "BIBLIOTECA NAZIONALE" and "NAPOLI") and blue smudges; the motto line and "Gemmina extla" are partly obscured by the stamp, so the motto words there are uncertain. Ornamental woodcut fleuron between "Editio" and "BASILEÆ" not transcribed. Handwritten shelf mark "XXXVII A 35" at foot not transcribed. Printed lines with "Lʒ" style long-s rendered as s.
